name: Decky Loader
description: Privileged self-update with zero verification; PR builds from unauthenticated nightly.link; plugin SHA256 bypassable with an empty hash.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

original_evidence.text: | Decky Loader | github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader | Python (aiohttp) backend + React/TS frontend, systemd service on SteamOS | Y — **both** self-update of the loader binary **and** a plugin store install/update flow (high interest: content-as-code) | self-update: **auto check** (every 6h + on demand) / **manual** download+install (user clicks "Update"; once triggered it downloads, installs, and restarts the service with no further confirmation). Plugin installs: manual, but user only confirms name/version — not the payload itself | Y — self-update downloads `PluginLoader`/`PluginLoader.exe` and the systemd service restarts to execute it (Linux binary is `chmod 777`'d); plugin store downloads ZIPs containing an arbitrary `main.py` that is imported and executed, plus optional extra "remote_binary" executables | HTTPS throughout (`api.github.com`, `plugins.deckbrew.xyz`, `nightly.link`); TLS enforced via `ssl.create_default_context(cafile=certifi.where())` — no `verify=False`/insecure override found | N (GitHub Releases API JSON / plugin-store JSON, unsigned) | **Mixed, and inconsistent:** self-update (`do_update`/`download_decky_binary`) — **NONE**, binary written straight from a GitHub release asset URL with no hash/signature check at all. "Testing"/PR builds (`download_testing_version`) — **NONE**, fetched from `nightly.link` (a third-party, unauthenticated GitHub-Actions-artifact mirror) then executed as the loader. Plugin store install (`_unzip_to_plugin_dir`) — **hash-from-manifest**, SHA-256 compared to a caller-supplied `hash`, but the check is **skipped entirely if `hash` is falsy/empty** (`if hash and (zip_hash != hash)`). Plugin "remote_binary" downloads (`download_remote_binary_to_path`) — SHA-256 **strictly enforced**, always compared, raises on mismatch | N/A everywhere — all are plain hash comparisons against values fetched from the same or a sibling unauthenticated HTTPS API; no cryptographic signing keys/PKI involved anywhere in the loader | `backend/decky_loader/updater.py:141-186` (`download_decky_binary` — no hash check, `chmod 777`, then `do_restart` executes it); `updater.py:264-293` (`download_testing_version` — `nightly.link`, zero verification); `backend/decky_loader/browser.py:58-64` (`_unzip_to_plugin_dir` — SHA-256 check bypassable via empty hash); `backend/decky_loader/helpers.py:110-132` (`download_remote_binary_to_path` — SHA-256 always enforced); `backend/decky_loader/helpers.py:23` (`ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=certifi.where())`) |

fields.label: framework
fields.value: Python (aiohttp) backend + React/TS frontend, systemd service on SteamOS

fields.label: has_updater
fields.value: Y — **both** self-update of the loader binary **and** a plugin store install/update flow (high interest: content-as-code)

fields.label: auto
fields.value: self-update: **auto check** (every 6h + on demand) / **manual** download+install (user clicks "Update"; once triggered it downloads, installs, and restarts the service with no further confirmation). Plugin installs: manual, but user only confirms name/version — not the payload itself

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: Y — self-update downloads `PluginLoader`/`PluginLoader.exe` and the systemd service restarts to execute it (Linux binary is `chmod 777`'d); plugin store downloads ZIPs containing an arbitrary `main.py` that is imported and executed, plus optional extra "remote_binary" executables

fields.label: transport
fields.value: HTTPS throughout (`api.github.com`, `plugins.deckbrew.xyz`, `nightly.link`); TLS enforced via `ssl.create_default_context(cafile=certifi.where())` — no `verify=False`/insecure override found

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: N (GitHub Releases API JSON / plugin-store JSON, unsigned)

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: **Mixed, and inconsistent:** self-update (`do_update`/`download_decky_binary`) — **NONE**, binary written straight from a GitHub release asset URL with no hash/signature check at all. "Testing"/PR builds (`download_testing_version`) — **NONE**, fetched from `nightly.link` (a third-party, unauthenticated GitHub-Actions-artifact mirror) then executed as the loader. Plugin store install (`_unzip_to_plugin_dir`) — **hash-from-manifest**, SHA-256 compared to a caller-supplied `hash`, but the check is **skipped entirely if `hash` is falsy/empty** (`if hash and (zip_hash != hash)`). Plugin "remote_binary" downloads (`download_remote_binary_to_path`) — SHA-256 **strictly enforced**, always compared, raises on mismatch

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: N/A everywhere — all are plain hash comparisons against values fetched from the same or a sibling unauthenticated HTTPS API; no cryptographic signing keys/PKI involved anywhere in the loader

fields.label: evidence
fields.value: `backend/decky_loader/updater.py:141-186` (`download_decky_binary` — no hash check, `chmod 777`, then `do_restart` executes it); `updater.py:264-293` (`download_testing_version` — `nightly.link`, zero verification); `backend/decky_loader/browser.py:58-64` (`_unzip_to_plugin_dir` — SHA-256 check bypassable via empty hash); `backend/decky_loader/helpers.py:110-132` (`download_remote_binary_to_path` — SHA-256 always enforced); `backend/decky_loader/helpers.py:23` (`ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=certifi.where())`)
